comparator.name: Franse taal en cultuur
comparator.sourceNotes: The full-time French Language and Culture pathway closes 60+60+60. Its required 30-EC abroad semester is separate from 30 EC of genuine free profiling, and the 12-EC final project is counted once. Diagnostic test 109121025Y and recurring tutoring 12402A025Y are mandatory zero-credit formation. Current module evidence supports Dutch, French and English instruction; full-time and part-time abroad timing are not conflated.
